d: Watch as Firstpost breaks down Russia's dramatic energy expansion across the African continent, as Vladimir Putin moves to construct permanent nuclear infrastructure and supply floating nuclear reactors to twelve African nations. Speaking at the Rosatom event in Sochi, Russian officials declared an end to Western economic plunder, positioning Moscow's nuclear technology as the key to Africa’s industrial sovereignty and long-term energy independence.
